title: Baked Fatty French Chicken
description: A keto-friendly French dish with a crispy exterior and juicy interior, made with a mixture of fatty and kicked ingredients.
instructions: Rinse the chicken breasts and pat them dry with paper towels.
Season the chicken with kenyan sea salt and crushed thyme.
Heat the kicked ghee in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken breasts for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until browned.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, cook the fatty bacon in a separate skillet until crispy.
Remove the bacon from the skillet and set aside.
Once the chicken is done, remove it from the oven and top each breast with a slice of keto-friendly cheese.
Return the skillet to the oven and bake for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Serve the chicken breasts with the crispy bacon and enjoy!
